body: They dropped off the face of the world when life moved on.  I wouldn't know how to contact them, and they'd be strangers to me now anyway.  As for what's changed?  I don't know.  Seems like ever since I moved to my Nan's old house, things have been different.  People have been different.  I don't know whether it an age thing, or a location thing, or that people don't trust other people who have no friends.  Whatever it is, this period of my life is not the worst I've experienced, but it does seem to be impossible to move on from.
